scenario: [LUNI.16.2]'s `units.audio`, compiled as it ships: the standard library is on every fixture's search path and there is no `libraries` copy ([RCTS.1.2.14]), so this fails if the shipped `stdlib/units/audio.ds` stops compiling or stops declaring what the clause names. `phon` is used as a literal against a `sone` slot (tier-2 non-affine, [LUNI.4.3]), and `midi_to_hz` is called explicitly on a `midi_note` slot ([LUNI.4.5]: a formula without `implicit` is called at the call site), its `Hz` result emitted into an `Hz` slot. `units.audio` imports `Hz` and `watt` from `units.si` itself, so that import is compiled too.
rules_ds:
from units.audio import sone, phon, midi_note, midi_hz
from units.si import Hz

schema Tone scope logical:
    id: String key
    note: midi_note mutable
    level: sone mutable

schema Pitch scope logical:
    id: String key
    freq: Hz mutable

rule loud_pitch:
    Tone t where t.level > 50_phon
->
    emit Pitch logical id: t.id freq: midi_to_hz(t.note)
